scope: One deterministic coordinate conversion of an already accepted affine-sliced n50 D4 quotient map. No closure or LFD claim is made by this conversion.
preconditions: The Python conversion and first native conversion are terminal with no final or partial output.
The 231526-row source has 37687 unit coordinates, 942 missing coordinates, and zero later-occurrence conflicts.
The source hash and published GitHub revision match.
controls: Fast output matches the generic reverse-greedy output on an 11-row exhaustive-kernel fixture.
Fast output matches the generic output on a 73-coordinate multiword fixture.
Wrong source hash is refused without an output file.
acceptance: Native process exits zero before its deadline and publishes an output digest.
The independent affine-slice checker accepts the rebased file against the original n50 plan and descent source.
The capacity profiler finds a unit-triangular seed and derives a bounded D5 payload.
interpretation: Only the independent checker can promote the output to an accepted D4 seed. D5 nonmembership and an LFD lower bound of six remain separate obligations.
